hero.title: Ready for the cluster.
hero.lede: Version 0.4.0 turns Dekopon’s local authority boundary into a distributable system: verified container images, a one-pod Helm design, safer credential delivery, and a Homebrew path for every executable.

highlights.title: Run the gateway and broker as one deliberate pod.
highlights.body: The chart follows the current Unix transport instead of hiding it behind a fake network service.
points: Two daemon containers sharing one 0600 Unix socket
Native broker sidecar gates gateway startup
Persistent audit and checkpoint state with no Service or Ingress

highlights.title: Use the same binaries everywhere.
highlights.body: The container is assembled from the release archives rather than compiling an unrelated second set.
points: Linux arm64 and amd64 in one manifest
Byte-for-byte checks against attested release archives

highlights.title: Move secrets into a pod without weakening their lifecycle.
highlights.body: Version 0.4.0 adds the export and deployment pieces needed by broker and ChatGPT credentials.
points: Owner-only broker files materialized by an init container
ChatGPT credential exported locally and seeded once

changes.title: The image reuses what the release already proved.
changes.body: All four executables are copied from the attested Linux archives, checked byte for byte after image assembly, and shipped beside the four provider components. The image contains no configuration, policy, credentials, or audit state.

changes.title: One pod preserves the real process boundary.
changes.body: The gateway and broker remain separate containers. They share only the current owner-only Unix socket, while a native sidecar startup probe orders them and reverse shutdown lets the gateway drain before the broker.

changes.title: Projected secrets become files the daemons will trust.
changes.body: A narrowly privileged init container copies Kubernetes projections into fresh regular files owned by UID 65532 with mode 0600. The daemons never mount the source symlink farm.

changes.title: Seed a rotating subscription credential exactly once.
changes.body: The operator CLI can export its isolated device-login credential under an explicit cleartext gate. The chart seeds it onto writable persistent storage and refuses to overwrite the live rotated copy on restart.

changes.title: Install all four executables from one formula.
changes.body: The tap formula is generated from the platform archives a release actually published. Version 0.4.0 supports macOS arm64 and Linux arm64/amd64; Intel macOS is intentionally retired.

telemetry.title: new privileges in v0.4.0
telemetry.body: Distribution changes where Dekopon can run, not which component owns authority. The gateway still holds no Cedar policy or provider credential. The broker still performs no model orchestration.
telemetry.note: The one-pod chart shares a Unix UID trust domain because that is the current transport contract. The limitation is explicit rather than hidden.

packages.name: Homebrew
packages.body: After tapping and trusting dekopon-agents/tap, install every executable and the example provider.

packages.name: Container
packages.body: Use one distroless image for the broker, gateway, runner, or operator CLI.

packages.name: Archives
packages.body: Download the release directly for macOS arm64 or Linux arm64/amd64.

current: A multi-architecture image assembled from attested release binaries
A Helm chart implementing one pod, two daemons, one UID, and one private socket
Owner-only file materialization for broker config, policy, and credentials
Persistent audit/checkpoint storage and seed-once ChatGPT credential storage
Homebrew formula automation and explicit ChatGPT credential export

Independent retention or signing of audit checkpoints
Operator-CLI integration with the broker and gateway
Agent memory that outlives one bounded conversation
Further production hardening and incident-response automation

previous.body: Version 0.3 introduced the unprivileged chat daemon, attested external subjects, strict Cedar authorization, per-agent broker credentials, persistent conversations, and the GitHub provider. Version 0.4 packages that system for deployment.
